name: Upper/Downward Camera
description: Downward-facing tool-mounted camera for viewing components in feeders and placement verification

fixed_offset.description: Manually determined camera offset from machine origin

machine_location.description: Not applicable - this camera is tool-mounted and moves with the tool

transform.description: Transform from pixel space to machine coordinates. Looking down: pixel +X → machine -X, pixel +Y → machine +Y

led_control.description: Fan 3 controls upper camera ring light
